descriptionHtml:
The lava stone grill 140 is an electric grill used for skewers of meat or fish and of natural, healthy, tasty and digestible grilled food.

Like the embers of wood, the lava rocks evenly distribute the heat over the entire cooking grid and absorb fat.

This professional electric grill allows for successive and alternating cooking of fish, meats, sausages without transmission of taste or smell.

The stainless steel fireguard fixed around the electric grill protects from possible cooking splashes.

This electric grill is very easy to clean. The dishwasher-safe lava rocks, the electrical box and the enamelled tray are fully removable.

Features:

  • energy regulator with 10 positions
  • control lights.
